claims.statement: Geometric state-space quantities may provide incremental information about climate regime transitions beyond conventional early-warning and state-space baselines.
claims.subject: geometric state-space methods
claims.scope: Unestablished; first tests are synthetic dynamical systems with known transition and non-transition cases.
required_evidence: numerical verification on known geometries
negative controls under coordinate transforms and rescaling
held-out discrimination against non-tipping nonstationary systems
comparison with conventional early-warning baselines
independent climate-model or observational confirmation before physical interpretation
unresolved_falsifiers: performance is explained by coordinate/scaling artifacts
no out-of-sample improvement over conventional baselines

claims.statement: A learned hierarchical or ultrametric representation may predict teleconnection relationships better than standard distance and dependence representations on selected tasks.
claims.subject: ultrametric and p-adic teleconnection methods
claims.scope: Unestablished; must be evaluated on predeclared teleconnection prediction/retrieval tasks with protected holdout periods.
required_evidence: comparison with correlation, coherence, graph, Euclidean, learned-metric, and generic hierarchical baselines
random hierarchy and random prime controls
time-aware holdout evaluation
mechanism-sensitive analysis where physical pathway claims are made
unresolved_falsifiers: p-adic or ultrametric variants do not outperform simpler hierarchy baselines
apparent gains disappear under protected temporal splits
prime assignments encode the target structure rather than discover it

claims.statement: Sheaf/cohomological obstruction measures may identify cross-source climate-data inconsistencies or coverage defects not captured as efficiently by simpler graph and residual diagnostics.
claims.subject: multiscale sheaf data consistency
claims.scope: Unestablished; first target is injected-fault and withheld-data station-network benchmarks.
required_evidence: actual chain/cochain or sheaf construction rather than threshold-count proxies
known-topology synthetic fixtures
injected station fault and coverage-gap experiments
comparison with graph, residual, kriging, and standard QC baselines
unresolved_falsifiers: topological quantities do not correspond to the intended mathematical invariants
simpler QC baselines match or exceed detection/reconstruction performance

claims.statement: Fisher-information-aware optimization may improve conditioning, convergence, or parameter recovery for selected climate inference problems relative to conventional optimizers and preconditioners.
claims.subject: information geometry and natural-gradient optimization
claims.scope: Unestablished; first target is a small model with an explicit likelihood and synthetic parameter-recovery task.
required_evidence: well-defined likelihood and Fisher metric
synthetic parameter recovery with known truth
held-out likelihood or prediction comparison
comparison with standard first/second-order optimizers and ordinary preconditioning
conditioning and regularization sensitivity analysis
unresolved_falsifiers: natural gradient provides no robust convergence or recovery advantage
benefit disappears when standard methods receive comparable preconditioning
Fisher approximation is unstable or dominated by regularization choices

claims.statement: A candidate-batched GPU geometry engine can reproduce an independent reference implementation within declared numerical tolerances while reducing the cost of comparing geometric hypotheses.
claims.subject: GPU experiment engine
claims.scope: Planned single-GPU reference-equivalence and throughput tests; software equivalence is epistemically independent of whether geometric regime indicators prove scientifically useful. Acceleration work remains planning-blocked until a useful workload and measured bottleneck exist.
required_evidence: explicit buffer and transfer contract
CPU or high-precision reference implementation
precision and conditioning sweeps
determinism classification
checked CUDA failure propagation
matched end-to-end performance measurement including declared transfer/setup costs
unresolved_falsifiers: GPU path changes scientific/numerical outcomes outside declared tolerance
performance benefit vanishes when full experiment costs are included
candidate batching introduces cross-candidate state contamination
